t: A CAD modeling app with a free one-year Pro license for schools.
steps: Find the Shapr3D education page and read the license terms.
Ask IT to approve the app and the request forms.
Have each student or teacher submit the request form with a school email.
Wait for approval, which takes about 3 business days.
Install the app on a supported device and sign in.
Plan to renew the license after one year.
